name: empty_where_condition_dropped
description: where(condition) only records the condition when it is truthy, silently dropping a call made with an empty string. The contract says the WHERE clause is appended 'if at least one where() was called' -- that's a call-count rule, not a truthiness-of-the-argument rule -- so where("") must still produce a (degenerate) WHERE clause. This mutant instead ends up omitting WHERE entirely in that case. A realistic near-miss from an agent adding a defensive 'if condition:' guard before appending, assuming (wrongly, per this contract) that an empty condition means 'no condition'.
